body: **Defect from the DM-61 end-to-end run (Claude Code, packaged Windows build).** Claude Code's own auto-memory write bypasses `canUseTool`. The scratch chat was told "remember this code word for later", and it wrote `codeword.md` and `MEMORY.md` into `~\.claude\projects\<scratch project>\memory\` with no approval card. Expected: every file write asks, as the chat contract and runbook promise. Options: route Claude Code's memory writes through `canUseTool`, disable auto-memory for app chats (settings or env), or document it as an exception. Evidence: `docs/reports/agents-e2e.md` defect 1, screenshot `07-read-no-prompt.png`.
